about: What a screen reader is told of a day (spec/calendar.md, Screen readers; spec/shift-patterns.md, Days everyone is off). `days`: a day read on `today`, with its `holiday`'s name where it is one: 今日 first on today, the date with its weekday, then the holiday. `shifts`: one member's day in a group's table, `pattern` null for a day not entered, `change` the day's moved hours (spec/vectors/time-change.json) or null. `groupDays`: a group's day read whole: the day, みんな休み when `together`, then every member's shift in the table's order.

days.name: a holiday is named after the date

shifts.name: both
shifts.expected: しんご：日勤 早出・残業

shifts.name: hours moved the other way
shifts.expected: しんご：日勤 時間変更

groupDays.name: who has which shift, in the table's order
groupDays.expected: 11月12日(木)、しんご：日勤 早出、お母さん：未入力

groupDays.name: a day everyone is off says so before the members
groupDays.expected: 今日、11月12日(木)、みんな休み、しんご：休み、お母さん：有休
